title: The Captain Below
summary: The Captain went into the mine in his sleep and has not come back. Every hour counts.

objectives.text: Follow the Captain into the Weeping Adit.

resolutions.journal: You found him asleep on his feet at a crossing and walked him home. He woke at his own door with mine dust to his knees.
You raised the Watch. They brought him up before dawn. It cost him some pride, and the town a long day of talk.
